attchmntText: BIL VYAPAR LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: BIL Vyapar Limited submitted the minutes of the 22nd meeting of the Committee of Creditors held on 14th November, 2026. The meeting commenced at 04:00 P.M. and concluded at 05:00 P.M. The Committee of Creditors noted the unaudited financial results along with the limited review report submitted by the auditor for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
